name: Adriano Santos
action: Adriano sets down the drum shell and the lug wrench, wipes his hands on a greasy rag, and walks to the rusted gate. He takes one bottle from Marcos and holds it unopened. He avoids eye contact briefly, then says in his loud, flat voice: 'One hour. I'm not playing. I'll come just to listen, then I leave early. And I'm bringing earplugs—I need to fact-check the rhythm, not blow out what's left of my hearing.' He leans against the gate, one hand still on the latch.
reason: Adriano recognized the beer as the same brand Marcos had brought on the day of his accident, when Marcos sat with him in silence for two hours, and he took that as a meaningful gesture. Having been in the garage alone all day with sore hands and a throbbing ear, and having repeatedly said online that live samba's authenticity depends on being in the room, he felt he should test that idea himself. Still, he did not want to commit to the whole evening, so he decided on a one-hour visit with no playing, no surdo, and earplugs as a practical precaution rather than a point of pride. Since Marcos was the only friend who still appeared at his gate and never brought up the accident or pressured him, Adriano felt he could give him this much, but only on his own terms, and he expected Marcos to understand when he stated his conditions directly.
